label: ESG Rating Questionnaire Pre-Filler
description: Pre-populates common ESG rating agency questionnaires (MSCI, Sustainalytics, CDP, EcoVadis) from available company data and publicly disclosed information.

guidedInputs.label: Company context
guidedInputs.placeholder: Company name, industry sector, geography, size (employees, revenue), any current ESG ratings or scores you have received.

guidedInputs.label: Existing sustainability disclosures
guidedInputs.placeholder:
What sustainability information have you already published or collected?
- Sustainability report (year)
- GHG emissions data
- Employee data
- Governance information
- Policies in place

Or upload your existing sustainability report via the file upload.

guidedInputs.label: Questionnaire sections you need help with
guidedInputs.placeholder: If you have the questionnaire, paste the specific questions or sections you are struggling with. If you don't have it yet, describe the areas where you expect to have gaps.

guidedInputs.label: Current ESG score (if known)
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., MSCI: BBB, Sustainalytics: 23 (Medium Risk), CDP: C

guidedInputs.label: Target score or rating improvement
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Target MSCI A rating, CDP B response, EcoVadis Silver
